data.standardized_narrative: For the 2022 financial year, Syndicate 3902 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 38.978 million, representing a 39.96% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by good loss experience on prior year reserves. While large events such as Hurricane Ian and the Ukraine conflict impacted the 2022 calendar year and prior years of account, their losses were within planned assumptions. The 2020 YOA closed with a profit of GBP 21.9m, and the ASML board approved a profit release of GBP 19.1m for the 2021 YOA.
